FRAME (decided with Shahab 2026-09-07; SECOND package label verified from photo 2026-09-08): UNTREATED-frame pair FND 2768188 + SR 173725. Waterfront Bistro bag (4x113g variant, Product of China - caught wild Alaska, processed/refrozen China): protein 15.9 / Na 119.5 / kcal 70.8 per 100 g = within ~8% of FND untreated (Na near-exact vs 114.8), despite the ingredient line DECLARING sodium tripolyphosphate. LESSON: an STP ingredient line does not mean the heavy-soak frame - the NUTRITION PANEL is the frame test.

AVOID-FRAME customer guidance (refined 2026-09-08): the heavy phosphate-soak population (FND 333476 = SR 175130: protein 12.2, Na 333, P 284) shows up on the PANEL, not the ingredient line - avoid bags reading sodium >=250 mg/serving or protein <14 g/serving; light-STP dips like Waterfront Bistro are fine.

PRE-REGISTERED LABEL REJECTION, DOUBLY CONFIRMED: the brand's own two printings claim vitamin D 6 mcg/serving (214 IU/100 g, online listing) vs 2 mcg/serving (71 IU/100 g, physical bag 2026-09-08) - self-inconsistent 3x, both far above every measurement. D row = 8 IU from SR 175130's analytical n=3 (range 4-16 IU, stats attached), unscaled (conservative); FND measured 0 below, MEXT analysed 20 above. If believed, the 214 claim would breach the 227 IU/1000 kcal legal max at ~1/2 recipe inclusion.

MEASURED-IODINE HIGHLIGHT: FND 2768188 iodine 185.5 ug/100 g (n=8) - the DB's first food with real USDA iodine. REVIEW MUST max-screen iodine: ~30% inclusion = ~480 ug/1000 kcal; check whether nutrient_limits carries an iodine max (if none, the no-max conservative-lens question applies).

Fish doctrine hooks: fish-diet vitamin K rule -> pairs with K1 corrector 10065 (3 tablets/1000 kcal); very lean (fat ~1) -> tallow 10064 is the natural diluent; gadids are LOW-THIAMINASE (safer raw than herring/smelt-class) and LOW-MERCURY - both worth customer-facing notes.
SR 173725 is a thin 45-nutrient stub (no AAs) but FND 2768188 carries the full 12/12 AA panel natively; SR contributes kcal 76 and handbook proximates.

SPECIES MAP for sources: Alaska/walleye pollock (Gadus chalcogrammus) EXACT = MEXT 10199, BLS T213100, CIQUAL 26006. Saithe/coley (Pollachius virens) = SIBLING species bracket = CoFID 16-383, FCDB 66. European pollack (P. pollachius, FCDB 587/CIQUAL 26129) EXCLUDED - third species.

Fish-family anchors (validated): taurine salmon 130 (Spitze same-item), tilapia 84 (estimate); vit K salmon 0.5/tilapia 1.4/mussel 0.1 (marine ~nil - the reason the fish K rule exists); chloride salmon 56/tilapia 61; iodine here is MEASURED, no anchor needed.
